title: Simple Interest Calculator: I = P × r × t With Months
description: Free simple interest calculator: enter principal, annual rate and time in years and months to see total interest, the final amount and how it compares with compounding.
lead: How much interest will a deposit or loan earn if interest is only charged on the original amount? Enter the principal, the yearly rate and the time to see the interest, the total and how it compares with compound interest.
